svg.title: SYCEE architecture
svg.desc: An agent pays a merchant over x402. The merchant and the agent SDK sign a receipt. SYCEE fingerprints that receipt and a restricted key anchors the fingerprint on NEAR. Anyone can verify it. The hosted evidence service is planned. No custody, no fund movement, no scoring.
svg.text: A signed receipt for an agent payment, fingerprinted on NEAR, so anyone can verify it.
Proposed pilot with partners. Not built in this repository. It would keep copies of receipts that are already signed.
No custody · No fund movement · No scoring
The chain stores a timestamped fingerprint. Anyone can read it. It does not score anyone, and it does not hold funds.
